title: Path to History of Sevilla's Architecture-and more!
text: Pablo was a fantastic guide for our 3 hour bike tour! He is knowledgeable about the architecture of Triana and Sevilla. He also provided an easy pace with clear biking directions along the bikeway. His knowledge of the history of the langues spoken here and the Baroque,  Gothic, Renaissance and the Mudejar were thought provoking. Thank you,  Pablo!

title: A fun way to see Seville

title: Fun way to tour Seville
text: We’re a family of 4 (2 adults, 2 12-year-olds) and we had a great experience. Pierre was our tour guide and he was great. He was knowledgeable and made the history fun and interactive for us and the kids. Would highly recommend!
author: nevine2412

title: We had an amazing time on the Segway tour in Seville!
text:
Our guide, Milena, made the experience truly unforgettable. She was incredibly knowledgeable, sharing fascinating stories and historical insights about the city at every stop. Her enthusiasm and passion for Seville’s history really brought the tour to life.

The Segways were easy to use, and Milena made sure we were comfortable and confident before setting off. The tour was well-paced, allowing us to explore Seville’s beautiful landmarks without feeling rushed.

If you’re visiting Seville, I highly recommend this tour – it’s a fun, informative, and unique way to see the city!
author: javiermonton

title: Great Tour and Experience
text: Miguel did an excellent job showing us around the city and suggesting places to go a things to see while in Buenos Aires. He even told us about a free polo match that we enjoyed after the tour that we would have never known about if it wasn’t for him. He is also very knowledgeable of the history of the city and the people of Argentina. It was a great way to start our trip and get a lay of the land.
author: mjjk713

title: An unforgettable first experience, thank you Pierre
text:
We found this activity through Get your guide but finally booked directly. We took a superb Private Tour of Seville with Pierre. He showed us places we had not yet seen. There were three of us.
It is extraordinary and made this first time in Segway just great. He recommended us some tip top places!
I highly recommend this tour and guide.
